summary: Newton Golf Company filed an 8-K after the September Investor joined its August 14, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement and closed a second tranche of a private placement. The investor bought 215,079 common shares at $1.26 per share, generating $271,000 gross proceeds. The placement is tranched, starting at a $1,000,000 first tranche (closed August 14, 2026) and continuing through additional tranches up to $5,000,000 aggregate. The investor also signed the Registration Rights Agreement. This is an ordinary private placement of common stock, not a special situation.
